text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 4px #005fcc outer ring with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This keeps the ring highly visible against any background while maintaining a clean look. The trade-off is slightly more visual weight, but it ensures keyboard users always see where focus is—critical for accessibility.

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring risks failing on patterned backgrounds where the white inner ring may blend into the pattern. A better alternative is a 3px solid white ring with a 1px black outer ring—it’s more reliable across backgrounds but risks failing on high-contrast patterned backgrounds. Settle it by testing on 3 patterned backgrounds at 200% zoom—if any fail, switch to a 2px solid white ring with a 2px black outer ring.

name: Reader
text: A 3px white ring with 1px black outer ring still risks failing on patterned backgrounds where the black ring blends into dark areas. A better alternative is a 4px solid #005fcc ring with a 2px white inner ring—it’s more reliable across all backgrounds. Settle it by testing on 3 high-contrast patterned backgrounds in both light and dark modes.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt a 2px #fff inner ring with a 1px #000 outer outline for focus indicators, ensuring sufficient contrast and minimal visual weight. The result must deliver a visible and accessible focus indicator across all backgrounds, and the lead developer owns the implementation of this design element.
